description: The bench rig until 2026-11-20: the MJKDZ INA228 breakout and its R100 shunt, with both the DUT lead (K1) and the bypass on the HW-316 four-relay module; since 2026-10-31 the bypass ran on K3, driven from GPIO15 (docs/rig-wiring.md section 8).

wiring.kelvin: the sense lands on the shunt's own pins; the R100 is a two-terminal part, so the screws' share is inside the measured value (docs/rig-wiring.md section 1)

lead.description: HW-316 K1 (SRD-05VDC-SL-C), NC in series with the DUT's lead, active low

bypass.description: HW-316 K3 (SRD-05VDC-SL-C), NO across the shunt and K1, active low; its silver contacts do not close the ~10 mV dry circuit

controller: ESP32-S3-N16R8 on a DSX063-1 screw-terminal carrier (WCH CH343P)
